message.content:
Halo! Terima kasih sudah menghubungi kami.  
Maaf, saat ini ukuran **XS** memang tidak tersedia untuk produk tersebut. Apakah Anda tertarik mencoba ukuran lain (S, M, L, XL) atau ada produk lain yang Anda cari? Jika Anda memiliki nomor produk atau detail lebih lanjut, beri tahu kami supaya kami bisa membantu memeriksa ketersediaan atau memberi rekomendasi alternatif.
message.reasoning: The user says in Indonesian: "Hallo, ukuran XS tidak ada ya?" Means: "Hello, is there no size XS?" They likely refer to a product. We need to respond. We might ask for clarification or provide info. We don't have product context. We can ask which product. Or we can say we don't have XS. We can ask if they want to order a different size. We can also offer to check inventory. We can ask for product ID. We can respond politely. No tool needed.
